result.title: From Pairwise to Collective: Encoder Collections Make Unpaired Vision-Language Alignment Reliable
result.summary: Strong vision and text encoders can be trained independently, but their representations are not directly comparable. Connecting them usually requires paired image-text data, which may be unavailable. Unpaired alignment instead fits a map between a vision and a text encoder from feature-space geometry alone, enabling text-based retrieval and zero-shot classification without paired data. Treating each pair independently leads to fragile searches, repeated fitting, and uncertain map quality. A collection of encoders supplies additional supervision: all vision encoders embed the same images and all text encoders the same texts. Correspondences within each modality are therefore known exactly, while the cross-modal correspondence remains hidden. ConsensusAlign pools each modality into a shared space, fits one unpaired cross-modal bridge, and transfers it in closed form to every encoder pair. New encoders join through same-modality fitting without repeating the cross-modal search. On 21 vision-text encoder pairs and five seeds, pooled fitting aligns every pair, whereas pairwise fits fail in 68 of 105 pair-seed cells. Mean alignment error (FOSCTTM) falls from 0.1457 to 0.0099, and zero-shot accuracy nearly doubles on ten datasets. Gains persist across the tested within-modality pooling constructions with a WP bridge. New corpora reuse the bridge through native maps fitted to unlabeled target features from every source encoder. Agreement with separately fitted reference maps detects failures on COCO.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究无配对数据下的视觉-文本编码器对齐：利用多个编码器共享同一模态内对应关系，将各模态池化到共同空间后拟合一次跨模态桥接，并以闭式变换迁移到所有编码器对，在 21 对编码器和五个随机种子上显著降低对齐误差。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「多个编码器提供额外监督、单次跨模态拟合与闭式迁移」及用参考映射一致性检测失败的做法，可能为 LVR 中跨表征空间对齐 latent 状态、读取视觉内容与判定对齐可靠性提供可核查的方法线索，但原文并不涉及推理期状态生成或证据使用。
